scripts.build:runtime: npm run build:runtime:js && npm run build:runtime:types
scripts.build:all: npm run build:runtime && npm run build
scripts.lint: eslint app src packages tests scripts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write app src packages tests scripts .github docs vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts README.md CHANGELOG.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check app src packages tests scripts .github docs vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts README.md CHANGELOG.md
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:all && npm run test:runtime-package
scripts.verify:release: npm audit --audit-level=high && npm run verify && npm run check:runtime-types && npm run test:browser
